note: Produced from data/labels/ by eval/validate_detection.py. Nothing in pipeline/ reads this file, and nothing in it is ever sent to a model.

held_out.reference_note: Fitted and calibrated on. Scoring the detector on these would measure nothing.
held_out.stale_note: Scored against a different baseline than the majority of runs -- almost always files left behind by an earlier pipeline run. Delete them and re-run S6 to clear this.

detection.position_caveat: Position is samples from the start of the run, not a detection delay: these labels mark the run, not the sample the fault began at.

semantic_agreement.verdict: S4 assigned one class to every column: the structural split present in the source naming was not recovered.
